name: Transformer SER Benchmark (Speaker-Independent)
description: Aggregates and compares transformer model performance for speaker-independent speech emotion recognition across datasets.
reputation: Moderately used within the speech-emotion research community for comparing transformer-based, speaker-independent systems.
notes: Benchmarks suffer from small dataset sizes, class imbalance, and high speaker variability; reported scores are sensitive to whether UAR or macro-F1 is used.
